description: Jabra Evolve 3 85 was recently launched in India as the company's latest flagship over-the-ear headphones. Currently listed on Amazon with a price tag of Rs. 88,220, the headphones are more expensive than Apple's AirPods Max 2 and Sony's WH-1000XM6. However, the Jabra Evolve 3 85 does not focus solely on offering premium sound. It is a purpose-built audio device, meant to serve the needs of office workers who are on conference calls for long hours. Apart from offering great comfort for long hours, the headphones also offer really long battery life and an impressive call experience. However, the pair of headphones also delivers great sound reproduction for listening to music and watching movies.
title: Jabra Evolve 3 85 Review: Premium Work Headphones That Go Beyond

description: WhatsApp can ban a user’s account if the user or the user’s number violates its terms of service. What’sApp actually has a set of conditions and “best practices” along with “practices to avoid” that users can peek into to find out why their account may have been banned. In case your account gets banned, read on to find out what you can do to avoid making things worse.
title: WhatsApp Account Banned? How to Request a Review and Recover Access

description: Sony India’s Head of BRAVIA business, Ranvijay Singh, breaks down how True RGB Mini LED coexists with OLED, why 85-inch and 98-inch 4K TVs are gaining traction beyond metros, and how Google TV and local 4K sports processing shape Sony's India lineup.
title: Sony's True RGB Mini LED Isn't Meant to Replace OLED, Says BRAVIA India Head

description: After more than a decade of waiting, Grand Theft Auto VI is finally here. The latest entry in Rockstar Games’ blockbuster franchise has arrived to widespread critical acclaim, with early reviews calling it one of the best games ever made. It retains the open-world freedom that has defined the series, but adds considerably more depth to its world and activities than Grand Theft Auto V. Vehicles remain central to exploring Leonida and the surrounding locations. Players have a wide range to choose from, including cars, motorcycles, boats and aircraft.
title: GTA 6 Cars And Vehicles Guide: Full List of Cars and Other Vehicles Available in Grand Theft Auto VI

description: Jio has announced its new Happy New Year 2.0 plans that are available in monthly and annual recharge options. Both plans come with plenty of benefits and OTT subscriptions, including a free Canva Pro and Pro Lite subscriptions.
title: Jio Happy New Year 2.0 Recharge Plans Launched With Unlimited Data and Canva Subscription

description: After several leaks and teasers, Motorola today finally took the wrap off its latest Edge-branded smartphone called the Edge 70 Neo. The Edge 70 Neo is priced joins Motorola’s Edge series of mid-range smartphones and is available in four unique finishes.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo Launched in India with Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 Chipset, 7,000mAh battery: Price, Specifications

description: Having trouble getting 5G to work on your phone? Several things could be affecting your connection, from limited network coverage and incompatible SIM cards to incorrect settings and power-saving features. This guide explains how to check whether your phone and mobile plan support 5G, enable the network on Android and iPhone, and troubleshoot common connection problems. It also covers a few other things to try, including restarting your phone, installing updates and resetting your network settings.
title: 5G Not Working on Your Phone? How to Fix Network and Settings Problems

title: Motorola Signature 27 India Launch Date Announced, Availability Details Revealed: Specifications, Expected Price

title: Best 5G Smartphones for Parents and Senior Citizens in India Under Rs. 20,000

description: GTA 6 offers plenty of options to choose from when it comes to weapons, such as pistols, handguns, revolvers, submachine guns, shotguns, assault rifles, sniper rifles, tactical rifles, machine guns, knives, and throwables. There are numerous ways you can get your hands on one of the weapons listed above. However, GTA 6 will not always let you keep the weapon you find. In some instances, you will also be forced to discard weapons that you do not own before opening your loadout vault. On top of this, some weapons will only be made available to you as you progress through the main story or complete side quests. Hence, it is important that you keep exploring and moving ahead.
title: GTA 6 Weapons Guide: Full List of All Guns and Items Available in Game
